title: Pi Kappa Alpha (Pike) Fraternity House
address:
5800 San Amaro Drive
Coral Gables, Florida 33146
United States
description:
The Pi Kappa Alpha (Pike) fraternity house provides student housing near the University of Miami in Coral Gables. The building is owned by West Range Coral Gables LLC, a private entity run by Pike alumni officers rather than the fraternity's national headquarters.

The house includes a chapter room for meetings and sports, shared common living areas, a pool deck, and multi-room suites with private bedrooms and bathrooms.
